title: Existence of closed non-planar $p$-elasticae
summary: We prove existence of closed non-planar $p$-elasticae for general exponents $p\in (1,\infty)$. In particular, we show that for any $p \in (1,\infty)$, there exists a countable family of non-planar $p$-elasticae, which are realized as torus knots. This generalizes well-known results of Langer--Singer for the quadratic case $p=2$ to general exponents $p\in (1,\infty)$.
